pages.title: Quarter Horse
pages.text: Stocky and broad-chested, very fast over short distances. A reliable all-purpose ranch horse.

pages.title: Explosive Burst
pages.text:
Named for outrunning anything over a quarter mile, and it is the first two seconds that earn the name. A Quarter Horse has **no acceleration delay**: ask it to go and it is already going, where any other horse spends a second winding up.

It does not raise the top speed - only how fast it gets there. For dodging, bolting and short sprints, nothing else compares.
